Description:
Behold, a knight clad in armor, commanding the king's army with unvavering determination, his presence inspiring the rallied masses trailing in his wake while striking fear into the hearts of the enemy ranks! A heavy blow of his lance shatters the enemy's defence line, clearing a path for victory. Radiating with divine energy of righteousness and bearing the standard of his allegiance, the Knight fearlessly presses forward, to victory!
Knights are the knights, the crusaders and the vigilantes who bear divine magic through conviction and purpose, perhaps aided by their god, rather than mastery over the arcane. They are able to both heal, resist damage and fell enemies with holy retribution.
Be it by the sword, by the shield or by the book, Knights join (or form) an order or community of like-minded individuals, and follow their calling into battle - to attack, to protect, to serve for a greater future.
Quick Note: Knights are the knights, the crusaders and the vigilantes who bear divine magic through conviction and purpose, perhaps aided by their god, rather than mastery over the arcane. They are able to both heal, resist damage and fell enemies with holy retribution.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Warrior-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

Level 4 Creed (NOT in sequence).Creed of Vengeance: Damage + You can move through obstacles

Things I can give per higher Level Talen: Standard Abilities with 2 "After" effects rather than 1
Extras To Add: If you've killed such an enemy Type before..

~Formation~.Effect: Your party gains various bonuses depending on your formation!

~Advance!~.Effect: After making a weapon attack, you can make a free Movement Act for 1 meter.

~Delayed Valor~.Effect: You can store an After trigger and use it later.

~Valor Flex~.Effect: Your first Ability each Turn counts as {Teal(After)} every Act type.

~Axiom~.Effect: Roll 1d6 and convert it to Movement or Shielding.

~Perfect Form~.Effect: After you use all six Act types in a Combat, choose an Ability. It is always made with Valor this Combat and has no Cooldown.

~Honorable Duel~.Effect: Each Combat, choose an Enemy. You deal +10% Damage against eachother.

~Courageous Duel~.Effect: Choose a Unit. You and it can only target* eachother.

~Self-Sacrifice~.Effect:
Take 2d6 True Damage. Heal a different ally for 200% of the rolled amount.

{Teal('With Valor:')} They gain +1 Health Regen for the rest of the Adventure.
{Teal('Next:')} Damage Ability
~Self-Sacrifice~.Notes: Can not be used on other Knights or characters with a Health Transfer Ability.

~Liberating Judgement~.Effect:
Deal 2d4 Damage to a Unit (you choose the Damage Type).

{Teal('With Valor:')} Then move a number of meters equal to the lower of the dice.
{Teal('Next:')} Damage Ability

~Outpost~.Effect:
Choose either a First Aid Tent or an Outpost Tower to build from scratch.
Once per Adventure, the tent can heal everyone inside for 1 Health.
While within 50km of the Tower, your party can't be ambushed, has +2 in Sight, and halves the travel time of your party.
~Outpost~.Upgrade: For smaller-scope adventures, the Quest Master can reduce the distance of the Tower to 10km.
~Outpost~.Notes: Try to build towers within 100km of eachother, and in places you may want to visit multiple times. Construct a network of such towers!

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (and tell your Ally to do so).

~Nominate Squire~.Effect:
Nominate a Hero from your party to become your _squire_ - your trusted companion and helper in your quest.

Your squire gets -2 Max Health, but you get +3 Max Health.
Whenever one of you would get a Quirk, you can choose to deny it, and be given a different Quirk that fits the situation.
~Nominate Squire~.Upgrade:
Your squire has doubled inventory capacity and you can instantly swap items from eachother with 0 Action Points (if near eachother).
They also have +2 in War Machines.

~Vows~.Requirement: Only usable in Campaigns with multiple sessions
~Vows~.Effect:
Vow on achieving a goal that would take at least 1 full Adventure.
Upon reaching your goal, you get a number of Positive Quirks equal to the number of sessions it took.
~Vows~.Upgrade: You can only have one vow at a time. Abandoning a vow gives you a Negative Quirk.

~Trusted Steed~.Effect:
You have a steed that increases your Movement Speed by 50%.
In Combat, your first Damaging Act dismounts you, but deals +1d4 Damage or Slams the target 1d4 meters away (if Targeted).
~Trusted Steed~.Upgrade: At Level 3, your Steed can climb steep hills and jump up to 5 meters. At Level 6, it can walk on water. At Level 9, it can fly.
~Trusted Steed~.Notes: The steed can be any animal that fits the story. When dismounting, your steed runs away and disappears into the surroundings. Once per real hour, you can whistle for your steed and it will appear running toward you and you automatically mount it.

Starting Abilities Description: Playing a Knight can be challenging. If you truly can't chain together some of your Abilities, don't worry about it too much. It's all about planning in advance!

~Actions With Valor~.Effect: Your Abilities and attacks in Worthy Combat may trigger extra effects if made immediately {Teal('After')} an Act that did a certain type of _thing_.
~Actions With Valor~.Upgrade:
The previous Act can be from your previous Turn, but from before Combat.
_Protection_ means giving Shielding, absorbing Damage, etc.
Slamming or Pushing count as _Status Effects_.
~Actions With Valor~.Notes: You can take a look at the ^tags^ of an Ability to see what kind of effects it can do. The {Teal('After')} effect can only trigger if the previous Act actually did that type of ^thing^. For example, "{Teal('After')} Mass Damage" can only trigger if the previous Act did Damage to more than 1 Unit. Apply common sense, and the Quest Master has the final say for whether an {Teal('After')} can trigger.

~Challenge of Arms~.Effect:
Roll 1d8.
Gain that as a Shielding, or Heal yourself for 50% of that.
Deal that as Smash Damage to a Unit, 50% of that to Units within 3 meters of you.
Slam yourself for that, or another Unit in any diretion for 50% of that.
~Challenge of Arms~.Notes: Use this to start a chain of Abilities With Valor! When you repeat this, choose the effects again and roll dice as normal. Obviously, the repeat does not retrigger another repeat.

~Chivalric Privilege~.Effect: Pick 2 Talents from the Level 1 Core Knight set.

Other Abilities Description: Choose 2 of the following Talent options.

~Row Through~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack with +1 Damage per {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Status Effect:')} Hits one more Unit within 2 meters of the main target with -50% Damage.

~Cowards!~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Unit within 2 meters.
Give them and yourself a _shared_ 1d6 Shielding.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} The Range is 5 meters and you dash in front of it.
~Cowards!~.Upgrade: The _shared_ Shielding is automatically consumed when _either_ of you takes Damage.
~Cowards!~.Notes:
This shared Shielding has priority over other Shieldings in reducing Damage.
In ^front^ of the Unit means on the closest space in front of where they are facing.
You dash ignoring obstacles. Requires Line of Sight, and dashing requires a mostly ^clear^ path (meaning of ^clear^ up to the Quest Master).
~Cowards!~.Tips: In certain situations, you might want to target an Enemy, so you can dash closer to them!

~Platinum Storm~.Effect:
Use a weapon to deal 2d4 + 2d6 Damage on a 3x3 meter area, of the weapon's Damage Type.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Does not Damage Allies, but Heals an ally caught for one of the rolled dice.
~Platinum Storm~.Notes: Each healing d4 must be target a different Ally.

Variants.Effect: All Units you pass through are Slammed 2 meters to the side (requires a Trusted Steed).
All Units you pass through are Slowed.

~Blade of Liberation~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for 1d8 and remove a Status Effect from them.

{Teal('After Movement:')} Then deal 200% of that die as ^weapon^ Damage to a Unit within 3 meters of you.

~Provocation~.Effect:
Slam a Unit 3 meters towards you, or 3 meters away from you.

{Teal('After Healing or being Healed*')} Daze it instead of Slamming, then gain a 1d6 Shielding.
~Provocation~.Upgrade: The {Teal('Valor*')} extra effect may trigger even if you were affected by a Heal on someone else's Turn.

~Charging Stallion~.Effect:
Charge in a straight line to any location on the battlefield.
All Units you pass through _shuffle_ their positions.

{Teal('After Status Effect:')} Give yourself or a Unit you passed through 2 Shiedings, each equal to how many Units you passed through.
~Charging Stallion~.Upgrade: Each Shielding can go into a different Unit.
~Charging Stallion~.Notes:
Units you hit swap their positions between them _randomly_ (as chosen by the Quest Master). For example, the first Unit hit might swap positions with the last Unit hit.
Optionally, you can use this to exit the battlefield and the Combat.
Shuffling positions does not count as a Status Effect.

~Templar Retribution~.Effect:
Blind a Unit and gain 1 {Gold}Gold.
Then permanently increase the {Gold}Gold gained from this by 1d4.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Dash to the Unit, Slam it in any direction for the 1d4 rolled, and further increase the {Gold}Gold generated by 1d4.
~Templar Retribution~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Blockade~.Effect:
Use when another Unit within 2 meters would take Damage.
Gain a 1d4 Shielding and take the incoming Damage instead of that Unit.

{Teal('After Movement:')} After blocking the Damage with the d4, Slam the attacker the same number of meters away from you.

~Font Knight~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to cast Spells from. You have all Spells from that Font up to your Level.

Whenever you would trigger an {Teal('After')} Valor effect, you can cancel that extra effect to gain 0.5 {Mana}Mana.
~Font Knight~.Notes:
The unspent {Mana}Mana lass until the end of Combat. The {Mana}Mana can only be gained and spent in Worthy Combat.
You can change your Font and Spells inbetween Adventures.

~CATAPULT!~.Effect:
Spend 300 {Gold}Gold to craft a special Large catapult that you can take with you on your adventures!

Instead of triggering your {Teal('After')} valor effects, you can activate your catapult to give it 1 {A}Action Point.
~CATAPULT!~.Upgrade:
Anyone can push the Catapult by simply moving from behind it, without penalties.
You can spend 1 hour to spend any amount of {Gold}Gold to Heal the Catapult for 50% of that.
You can only have 1 Catapult at a time.
~CATAPULT!~.Notes:
The Catapult occupies a 2x2 meter area. The Catapult can use 1 {A}Action Point to move on its own.
The Catapult can't make Checks, and has 2/-2/0/2 in Stats, if it ever needs them.

~HURL!~.Sieger: Deals +100% Damage against Constructs and buildings!

~Stand Strong, Fellows~.Effect:
Heal either yourself, or all other Allies within 2 meters for 1d2.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} Also Damages Enemies within 2 meters for 1d4 Psychic Damage.

~Ruin Lineage~.Effect:
The _strongest_ Enemy takes 3d6 Scourge or Pulse Damage, and the next strongest Enemy takes 50% of that.

{Teal('After Heal:')} Choose another Unit on the battlefield to take 50% of that.
~Ruin Lineage~.Notes:
Will only affect alive Units. ^Strongest^ is up to the Quest Master.
For each target, you can choose the Damage Type.

~Lance Unbound~.Effect:
Make a melee weapon attack that applies a ~Combo~ and has +1 Range for each {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Mass Damage:')} Heal an Ally for 1 for each {A}Action Point spent.

~Creed of the Crown~.Effect:
Your first moving* Act each Turn has its distance increased by 50%.
At the end of each Turn, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 100% the number of meters you moved this Turn.
You are immune to being Slowed, Rooted, and to Hard Terrain.
~Creed of the Crown~.Upgrade: You serve the realm above all else. Your sword defends law, order, and your liege's will.
~Creed of the Crown~.Notes:
Moving* bonus accounts for Pushing or Slamming, too!
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.

~Creed of the Rose~.Effect:
All your Abilities that can Heal do the {Teal(After)} effect regardless of the previous Act.
Your Abilities that can Heal that don't have an {Teal(After)} effect at all have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Creed of the Rose~.Upgrade: You are the knight of beauty and grace, a protector of the innocent, and a paragon of compassion.
~Creed of the Rose~.Notes: Healing Abilities that have an {Teal(After)} effect that doesn't Heal ^do^ trigger their {Teal(After)} effect anyway.

~Creed of the Dragon~.Effect:
You take -50% Damage from that dragon's element Type.
All your Abilities' Ranges, areas, and distances increase by 2 meters, become of the dragon's element Type, and you deal +1d4 Mass Damage*.
~Creed of the Dragon~.Upgrade: You swear your allegiance to an elder dragon you have encountered on your journey.
~Creed of the Dragon~.Notes: If an effect or Ability manages to deal Mass Damage, it deals +1d4 to all affected Units.

~Creed of Vengeance~.Requirement: Requires having been betrayed this Campaign, or having broken an oath
~Creed of Vengeance~.Effect:
You gain 2 Hatred Positive Quirks of choice.
For each die rolled with Targeted Damage, gain 0.01 Initiative and 0.05 Damage or Healing on a chosen Ability permanently.
After killing a Unit, you can move through obstacles* and enemy Units until the end of your Turn.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Upgrade: Justice has failed. Your oath was broken, your faith was betrayed, but you swore a new one: to hunt those who wronged you and make the world remember. You will bring justice, to the world and to yourself.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Notes: Obstacles* are not walls and ceilings.

~Creed of the Sun~.Effect:
You have +4 Max Health.
Whenever you inflict a non-Slam Status Effect, you can also Slam that Unit 1d6 meters away from you.
Whenever you Slam a Unit, they must choose to be Blinded, Lagged, or Frailed.
~Creed of the Sun~.Upgrade: You are the dawn that banishes despair. You ride with the light at your back and hope in your hand.
~Creed of the Sun~.Notes:
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Creed of Steel~.Effect:
You can wear 2 Shields at the time, both on the same hand.
Whenever you block some Damage with a Shielding, save the blocked amount as _Steel Points_, or give 50% of the blocked amount as a Shielding to an Ally you can see.
_Steel Points_ may last until the end of the Adventure.

~Rebuke~.Effect: {Teal('After Protection:')} Consume all _Steel Points_ to deal that much Damage of your Shield's Damage Type.
~Rebuke~.Notes: If your Shield has multiple Damage Type reductions, you can choose. If it has no Damage Type reducion, it's Smash Damage.

~Inevitable Cataclysm~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Inevitable Cataclysm~.Effect:
You declare war on your enemy, and wait for the perfect moment to obliterate them.

Choose a Unit you can see. At the start of your next Turn, you jump to them and strike them with your weapon for 5d10 Damage of your weapon's type. The impact ripples to Units within 2 meters, and each Unit caught takes 1 die less of the result per meter away from the main target. The Quest Master chooses which die to drop per meter.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} Ripples to Units within up to 5 meters, and Allies hit take -50% Damage.
{Teal('After Heal:')} Damage increases to 5d12
~Inevitable Cataclysm~.Notes: If the main target took 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11 Damage on the dice, then Units 1 meter away may take 8, 9, 10, and 11 if the Quest Master decides to drop the lowest die. Units 2 meters away take 8, 9, and 10 if the Quest Master decides to drop the highest die. And so on.

<Peasant! I Choose You!>.Effect:
You recruit a trusted beginner adventurer non-player character as a follower. It starts out with one _improvement_ from below, whichever makes sense for that person, or random. It has -1, 0, 0, 1 distributed among the Stats.
It acts on your Turn and has 2 {A}Action Points per Turn. At the end of every Worthy Combat, if the follower dealt and took Damage, it gains 1 XP, which it can spend to buy _improvements_ it chooses.
Only one can follow you in your journeys at a time.
<Peasant! I Choose You!>.Upgrade: Followers obey Hero rules for death and being Fallen. However, followers have no Health Regen, and instead replenish 50% of their Max Health at the end of each of your Adventures.
<Peasant! I Choose You!>.Notes: Your follower can get the same improvement multiple times, unless it's unique. It is not a Hero by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Hero). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!

SpellTable.Name: Healthy {XP}1
SpellTable.Effect: +2 {Health}Health

SpellTable.Name: Speedy {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: +1 Movement Speed

SpellTable.Name: Rangey {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: +1 Range on all attacks and Abilities

SpellTable.Name: Tanky {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: Gain a 1d4 Shielding at the start of each Combat.

SpellTable.Name: Bashy (Unique) {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if it rolled 6, Single-Stun the target.

SpellTable.Name: Slashy {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if it rolled 6, +1 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Flanky {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: Flank attacks deal +1 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Sneaky (Unique) {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: Follower can't be targeted on the first Round.

SpellTable.Name: Witchy {XP}2
SpellTable.Effect: When you get this, choose a Damage Type. Can freely change attack Damage to that type.

SpellTable.Name: Lighty {A}1 Action Point {Cooldown}Once / Adventure (Unique) {XP}3
SpellTable.Effect: Blind a Unit within 2 meters.

SpellTable.Name: Healy {A}1 Action Point {Cooldown}Once / Adventure {XP}3
SpellTable.Effect: Heal a Unit within 2 meters for 1d6.

Attack.Weaponize: Can be equipped with any magic weapon and benefit from its magic passive effects (e.g. not Critical Strikes). Damage does not increase.

~Knight's Corral~.Effect:
You make your surrounding area impossible to tresspass, except for your challenger of choice.

Choose a Worthy Enemy. All other Units within 4 meters of either of you are Pushed 3d4 meters away from between you. Until the start of your next Turn, no other Units can willingly come within 3 meters of either of you, and for the rest of the Combat, you both Heal for 100% of the Round number at the start of each Worthy Round.

{Teal('After Mass Damage:')} +1d4 and +100% Healing you two receive from this.
{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} +1d4 and Pushing becomes Slamming instead.
~Knight's Corral~.Notes: Units can't willingly enter the zone. If a Unit somehow gets in, they can't willingly move closer to either of them.

~Liege's Banner~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Liege's Banner~.Effect:
You detach your banner, and raise it above the battlefield, ready to throw it.

Throw your special banner onto a place on the battlefield, dealing 2d6 Pierce Damage to Units in a 2x2 meter area around its point and Healing the thrower for 1d4. The banner has 10 Max Health and absorbs all Damage the Knight's allies take.

{Teal('After Heal:')} Damage becomes 3d6 and area increases to 3x3.
{Teal('After Mass Damage:')} The banner's Health becomes 15 and Heal increases to 1d8.
~Liege's Banner~.Upgrade: Anyone can use 1 {A}Action Point to pick up the banner and throw it again, with the first throw's {Teal('After Valor')} effects!
~Liege's Banner~.Notes: You must spend 50 {Gold}Gold to craft the special banner, and you must draw a picture of what it looks like.

~Knightsville~.Effect:
You claim an open and available piece of land as your own.
For 100 {Gold}Gold, you can recruit a person as a villager to come live on your property and work on the various projects there. The village houses up to 3 people at first.
Each villager may have its own preferences for work types.

Each town project starts at 0 _work_ done. Every real hour, each villager can accomplish 1d4 to 1d10 _work_, based on personality and preferences.

Your village's Unhappiness starts at 25, but increases by 1d6 whenever a new villager joins the town.
At the end of each Adventure, produces 1d4 {Gold}Gold for you, and rolls 1d100 for happiness. If it rolls below the Unhappiness level, they may leave, get sick, die, steal {Gold}Gold, etc.
~Knightsville~.Notes: The Quest Master decides whether your villagers work during downtime or not. You need to come to town to collect the {Gold}Gold, but your villagers will follow your work commands even if you're not there. The Unhappiness reduction happens when the building is constructed, and is permanent until destroyed.

SpellTable.Name: House {Hammer}30 Work
SpellTable.Effect: +2 Population Cap, -1d4 Unhappiness

SpellTable.Name: Wall {Hammer}25 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d8 Unhappiness

SpellTable.Name: Cultural Building {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -2d8 Unhappiness

SpellTable.Name: Church {Hammer}40 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d10 Unhappiness. Once / Adventure, can Heal people inside for 1d6.

SpellTable.Name: Town Hall {Hammer}65 Work
SpellTable.Effect: Villagers have their ^Dice Upgraded^ for all work they do.

SpellTable.Name: Market {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: The {Gold}Gold generated by Villagers has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.

SpellTable.Name: Farm {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d4 Unhappiness. Each Farm further produces 10 {Gold}Gold per Adventure, but requires a villager to

SpellTable.Name: Guild Workshop {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: -1d4 Unhappiness. Each Shop has a type (blacksmith, library, bowyer, leatherworker, etc). At the end of each Adventure, each shop produces a magic item worth 1d100 {XP}Experience (or multiple of the same type, all together, produce an item worth that many d100 in {XP}Experience). Magic items from Guilds are sold at 20% of their value.

SpellTable.Name: Military Camp {Hammer}45 Work
SpellTable.Effect: +1d4 Unhappiness. Each military camp may send one villager to fight with you until death. Their Health may range from 5 to 15, Damage from 1d2 to 1d8, etc based on your workshops and number of Military Camps.

~Get Up, Stand Up~.Effect:
Remove all your party members' Exhaustion (from any source).
If they were Exhausted from lack of sleep, they can resist sleep Exhaustion for 8 more hours.
~Get Up, Stand Up~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Renown~.Effect: Each Adventure, the first time you enter each Worthy* friendly hub you didn't start in, gain 100 {Gold} and you have +1 to Presence Checks.
~Renown~.Notes: A friendly hub is a town or city where there are other non-player characters. It's considered Worthy if you didn't enter it specifically to only gain the 100 {Gold}Gold.

~Obsession and Compulsion~.Effect: At the end of every Combat, if all your used {Teal(After)} Abilities triggered their {Teal(After)} effect, gain a Plot Point, +2 Max Health, and a random Positive Quirk.

~Black Knight~.Effect:
While wearing all black and at 50% or more Health, you can't take more than 10 Damage at a time.
You have +1 Movement Speed.

~White Knighthood~.Effect:
While wearing all white and at 90% or more Health, your Abilities trigger their {Teal(After)} effect anyway.
You have +1 Initiative.

<Man of Steel>.Effect:
While wearing Heavy Armor or a Tower Shield, Enemy ranged attacks against other allies within 1 meter of you have Cover.
You have +6 Max Health.
<Man of Steel>.Notes: Nothing happens if an ally near you already has Cover. If playing on a grid, this does work for allies diagonally.

~Echoes of Heritage~.Effect: Your next {Teal(After)} effect triggers 2 extra times.

~Sovereign Execution~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Sovereign Execution~.Effect:
You prepare to decimate the meek and using their life force as fuel for your conquest.

Your next attack propels you up to 5 meters towards the target, and heals you for 50% Damage done. If it leaves the non-Epic Unit with 25% or less Health, further deals extra Damage equal to its current Health and the Damage type becomes True.

{Teal('Status Effect:')} 100% Healing instead of 50%.
{Teal('After Protection:')} 50% Health execution instead of 25%.

~Damsel's Deliverance~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Damsel's Deliverance~.Effect:
You lock eyes with a target, and prepare to take them into oblivion.

Charge towards the target, grab them, and dash with it away from your original position until you hit a non-Unit obstacle. On impact, it takes 7d6 Smash Damage.

{Teal('After Movement:')} +3d6 Damage
{Teal('After Protection:')} Can now also collide with Units, and the impact Damage may work akin to Slamming a Unit into another.
~Damsel's Deliverance~.Notes: You grab the Unit and you both go flying, until you smash it into the first obstacle it collides with. If you reach 15 meters of uninterrupted dashing, you smash them into the ground and stop, dealing the Damage then and there.

~Divide and Conquer~.Requirement: Can't be used on the first Round
~Divide and Conquer~.Effect:
You stomp your weapons into the ground and divide the battlefield.

ALL Units in front of you take 4d8 Damage of your weapon's type and are Slammed back 1d8 meters. Each Unit behind you gains a 1d8 Shielding.

{Teal('After Status Effect:')} Units in the front also become Blinded.
{Teal('After Movement:')} Units in the back may make a free Movement on their next Turn.
~Divide and Conquer~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Master Falconer~.Effect:
You have a trusted falcon or a similar animal that scouts around and aids you in Combat.
Whenever you trigger an {Teal(After)} effect, the falcon dashes down and deals 1d4 Pierce Damage to the target, or give an affected ally a 1d6 Shielding, which disappears if the falcon moves away from the ally.

You have +3 in Scouting.

~Shatter Through~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack with ~+1d4~ Damage per {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Status Effect:')} Hits ~2 more Units~ within 2 meters of the main target with -50% Damage.

~Infidels!~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Unit within 2 meters.
Give them ~or~ yourself a ~1d10~ Shielding.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} The Range is ~10 meters~ and you dash in front of it.
~Infidels!~.Upgrade: There is no _shared_ on this Ability anymore.
~Infidels!~.Notes:
In ^front^ of the Unit means on the closest space in front of where they are facing.
You dash ignoring obstacles. Requires Line of Sight, and dashing requires a mostly ^clear^ path (meaning of ^clear^ up to the Quest Master).
~Infidels!~.Tips: In certain situations, you might want to target an Enemy, so you can dash closer to them!

~Silver Storm~.Effect:
Use a weapon to deal ~2d8 + 2d10~ Damage on a ~4x4~ meter area, of the weapon's Damage Type.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Does not Damage Allies, but Heals an ally caught for one of the rolled dice.
~Silver Storm~.Notes: Each healing die must be target a different Ally.

Variants.Effect: All Units you pass through are Slammed 1d8 meters to the side (requires a Trusted Steed).
All Units you pass through are Slowed.

~Blade of Condoleances~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for ~1d12~ and remove ~all~ Status Effects from them.

{Teal('After Movement:')} Then deal ~300%~ of that die as ^weapon^ Damage to a Unit within 3 meters of you.

~Indignation~.Effect:
Slam a Unit ~1d8~ meters towards you, or ~1d8~ meters away from you.

{Teal('After Healing or being Healed*')} ~Single-Stun~ it instead of Slamming, then gain a ~1d8~ Shielding.
~Indignation~.Upgrade: The {Teal('Valor*')} extra effect may trigger even if you were affected by a Heal on someone else's Turn.
~Indignation~.Notes:

~The Crown~.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
~The Crown~.Effect:
You become the king, emperor, or hierarch of a certain area or city.
In combat, you may be accompanied by up to 2 loyal Knight Heroes, who start at Level 3, and can Level Up like normal Heroes through the {XP}Experience system.

Also, your Max Health becomes 100 and can not change by any means, and you gain +2 in 2 Stats of your choice. You automatically pass all Hard Presence Checks while within your territory.

~The Last Knight~.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
~The Last Knight~.Effect:
As long as your other Hero party members are alive, your Health can not be reduced below 1.
You have all Level 9 Talents, and all numbers on your chosen Creed are tripled (except costs and the values of dice).

Also, you have +1 in all Stats.

~Legend of the Realm~.Effect:
All your {Teal(After)} effects trigger 1 extra time, and your first {Teal(After)} effect each Turn triggers its {Teal(After)} effect anyway.
Once / Adventure, you gain an item from any shop of the realm without paying for it, and all your food, housing, etc are taken care of for free.
You can rest for 30 minutes at a friendly place to immediately end the Adventure for yourself and start a new one.

Also, you have +4 Presence.
